meta.source: data/tiles/lola5m_site23.npz (NASA LOLA PGDA 5 m/px Site 23, Malapert massif; partly interpolated by LOLA)
meta.frame: scene: origin = lander (tile centre), x east, z south, y up; PNG row 0 = north

encoding: R*256+G -> 0..65535 maps to height_lo..height_hi; B = slope deg * 8
hazard_rule: official LOLA slope >= 12.0 deg (modelled hazard backup)
